useCases.title: Work the Booking Board queue
mainFlow: 2. Lists Submitted/Under Review requests ordered by ETA (ch15 SS11.1)
3. Filterable by terminal, status, ETA date range (ch29 SS24.1)

useCases.title: Review a booking request
postconditions: Status = UnderReview, reviewing officer recorded (ch15 SS11.2)
mainFlow: 1. Officer opens the request for review
2. Request is locked from agent edits (ch10 SS6.1)
3. Screen shows vessel dimensions vs berth limits, exceedance highlighted red (ch21 SS17.1)
4. Screen shows the last 5 bookings of the same vessel (workshop-notes.md Session 3, D2 — not in any numbered chapter)

useCases.title: Record an approval decision
preconditions: if CargoClass = DangerousGoods, an inspection must already be scheduled (ch22 SS18.2)
mainFlow: 1. Officer records Approved, Rejected, or Returned for Information, with a reason (ch16 SS12.1)
2. Returned-for-Information goes back to the agent, who may amend and resubmit once (ch16 SS12.2)

useCases.title: Override a rejected decision
postconditions: Override recorded with reason, IsOverride = Yes (ch16 SS12.3)
mainFlow: 1. Harbour Master overrides the rejection with a reason

useCases.title: Scope data access by company
postconditions: Agent sees only own company's bookings/invoices/inspections (ch35 SS29.1)
mainFlow: 1. Every list/detail microflow filters by the current user's ShippingAgent

microflows.name: ACT_BookingRequest_OpenForReview
microflows.purpose: Locks a Submitted request and moves it to UnderReview.

microflows.name: ACT_ApprovalDecision_Record
microflows.purpose: Records an officer's outcome and reason; gates on dangerous-goods inspection.
validations: CargoClass != DangerousGoods OR an Inspection exists for this Booking

microflows.name: ACT_ApprovalDecision_Override
microflows.purpose: Harbour Master-only override of a Rejected decision.

microflows.name: GET_BookingBoard_Queue
microflows.purpose: Retrieves Submitted/UnderReview requests ordered by ETA, filterable.

pages.name: BookingBoard_Overview
pages.purpose: Officer queue: Submitted/Under Review by ETA, filter by terminal/status/date

pages.name: OfficerReview_Screen
pages.purpose: Decision panel: dimensions vs limits (exceedance in red), last 5 vessel bookings, decision
